cards.label: Stratford — a car park
cards.text: The buyer turns the pearl over once, checks something on his phone, and pays. A woman walks past with a Lidl bag and doesn't look up.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "That's it. That's the whole deal." He counts £120 into your hand. "Most of them are that boring. Don't get used to it."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: He holds two more pearls out at arm's length, eyes streaming. "Just in case. Loadout's what you carry into a fight. Anything you want kept off the market goes in the stash."
